additional_info.subject: Antwort: 0471274 - ID0471274-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S9 170004121] Out of Order CRM:03289000174
additional_info.body:
Dear all,
I can't point it out to the exactly. The error occurred around 8 p.m. in the evening yesterday the 08th January.
The only reason I can share this is because I can see the LED light strips using our cameras on the area. At around 7:30 p.m. everything was still ok and the charging process could be defined and recognized based on the changing blue light.
An hour later everything was lit in static white light again!
The fact is that the loading process is canceled or ended after about 5 to 6 hours for no apparent reason and the Outlet 2 goes out of service.
In addition, we also tested this situation with different electric trucks, always the same error, regardless of the vehicle!
This definitely needs to be improved! Maybe the longer charging cable that was changed at Outlet 2 is also to blame for the failures!?
This needs to be checked on your part!
Best regards,
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Alexander Maaßen
